o: A hole in the wall. It is exactly Brannoc-shaped.
v: Damp stone. There's a hairline crack in it.
W: Damp stone. Someone has drawn an arrow on it, pointing at another arrow.
1: The ladder back down, to the cells.
2: A ladder up. Light, and voices, from above.
R: Names, scratched into the stone. Hundreds of them. Most are crossed out.
Near the bottom, deeper than the rest: THE KING HAS NOT AGED A DAY. WE HAVE.
Under it, in another hand: Five hundred years ago a shadow stood behind the throne. It still does.
Under that, very small: Gary was here.
